title: Fix another few spelling errors.
description:
applicaton -> application
atribut -> attribute
deliminator -> delimiter
depricated -> deprecated
disect -> dissect
parmeter/paramater -> parameter
poitner -> pointer
recomment -> recommend
suport -> support (except one instance in packet-windows-common.h from source material)
uncertaintly -> uncertainty
unkown -> unknown

notes.body: This one is an externally sourced file, so this is a typo in that. To have any effect on the dissector (I don't know if changing this field does), the fix dissector would have to be regenerated.

The typo does not appear in the generated dissector, so it seems that this part of the source .xml file is in fact unused.

But... checking this did reveal that c30ccfc3 accidentally converted `TRUE GROSS YIELD` and `TRUE YIELD` to `true GROSS YIELD` and `true YIELD` in the generated dissector, and that def38624 corrected the spelling of `MININIZE` to `MINIMIZE` in the generated dissector without fixing the spelling in the source .xml files, so I'll clean those up now too.

commits_data.message:
Fix another few spelling errors.

    applicaton -> application
    atribut -> attribute
    deliminator -> delimiter
    depricated -> deprecated
    disect -> dissect
    parmeter/paramater -> parameter
    poitner -> pointer
    recomment -> recommend
    suport -> support (except one instance in packet-windows-common.h from source material)
    uncertaintly -> uncertainty
    unkown -> unknown

Re-generate packet-fix.h.
